selection: candidate selected using training significance, validation direction, and training cross-variable specificity

tier_definitions.A: test direction survives; all eligible held-out marker and domain groups preserve direction; target is strongest associated variable for feature
tier_definitions.B1: complete construction robustness but feature is shared/non-specific
tier_definitions.B2: test direction survives with substantial but incomplete construction robustness
tier_definitions.C: overall test direction survives but subgroup robustness is poor
tier_definitions.D: selected feature does not preserve direction on overall held-out test

important_note: Evidence tiers are descriptive summaries, not additional hypothesis tests.
